In essence, these descriptors can help doctors better understand the structure and characteristics of the internal carotid arteries, which may aid in identifying thrombi versus plaques. This information can be critical in making an accurate diagnosis and developing a treatment plan for patients with suspected carotid artery stenosis or thrombosis.
